title: Standardized Minimal API Validation Test Framework
description: A lightweight, library-agnostic test framework that validates API behavior through minimal examples before full implementation. Should detect incompatibilities like the h-e1 run 1 failure (transformers API returning empty tuple when expected non-empty).
